title: Not Bad but Not the Best
text: Not Bad but Not the Best. This is really not a bad product because it arrives almost assembled; so assembly is really easy compared to the bigger futons. Unfortunately, I did not read the product dimensions and it is smaller than the normal futons. It is well made, however, the futon cushion is not real soft; it is a firm seat. The cup holder works great but the side cushions are worthless; the velco doesn't hold them in place at all. This would probably work well for young adults but for normal adults you may not like the feel or size once you own it. This is one of those think about purchases.
